purpose: Pinned tool versions for the permanent CoreMap PMTiles build machine (Windows/WSL Ubuntu).

tippecanoe.install_hint: Build tippecanoe 2.79.0 from https://github.com/felt/tippecanoe and install to ~/.local/bin

tile-join.note: Ships with the tippecanoe package; version should match tippecanoe.
tile-join.install_hint: Build tippecanoe 2.79.0 from https://github.com/felt/tippecanoe and install to ~/.local/bin

pmtiles.install_hint: Install go-pmtiles v1.31.2 Linux x86_64 binary as `pmtiles` on PATH (e.g. /usr/local/bin/pmtiles).
